newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil coffee group Febec opens Internet home page.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee group Febec opens Internet home page.

text.p: Brazil's Association of Coffee Exporters (Febec) said it has set up an Internet home page with daily updated statistical data on exports of green coffee.
The page contains daily and monthly figures of origin certificates required by Brazilian exporters, which serve as an indicator of future Brazilian coffee exports, Febec said in a statement.
The page also contains daily and monthly figures for exports based on bills of lading, which show how much coffee has been shipped, it added.
In addition, the page provides information about the association, directors and members.
Febec site can be accessed at http://www.mlcbbs.com/febec/. --Romina Nicaretta, Sao Paulo newsroom, 5511 232 4411.
